title: Military base calls a witness after the Fox interview

tellings.quote: right the military base calls the guy that we had just met with on camera

plain: James Fox, a documentary filmmaker who investigates UFO cases, says that around 2021 or 2022 in Brazil he filmed an interview with a local witness. Right after that, according to Fox, a military base phoned the man they had just met on camera. He tells it as a sign that the military was keeping close watch on who was talking to him.
